This plot is very small, only about a quarter of an acre, and it is not my main field — my bigger land is where I put most of my money and time. For this small one I will use what I have at home: some manure from the few animals we keep, and local seed I saved from last season. I do not want to buy a whole bag of fertilizer for such a small piece when my other plots need it more, and the rains here in Mbeya are usually good enough. My wife and I will handle the work ourselves; no need to hire anyone for a plot this size.
